tasks.title: Develop product and customer management features
tasks.description: Implement CRUD functionality for store owners and sales personnel to manage products and customer accounts.

tasks.title: Develop storefront browsing and cart operations
tasks.description: Implement product catalog browsing and shopping cart management for customers.

tasks.title: Develop order submission processing
tasks.description: Implement order creation logic, requirement for sign-in, and feedback of order reference.

acceptance_criteria.given: a store owner or sales personnel is logged in
acceptance_criteria.when: the user creates a new product with valid details
acceptance_criteria.then: a new product is recorded in the system

acceptance_criteria.given: a store owner or sales personnel is logged in
acceptance_criteria.when: the user creates a new customer account
acceptance_criteria.then: a new customer account is created

acceptance_criteria.when: the visitor browses the available products

acceptance_criteria.given: a product is available in the store
acceptance_criteria.when: the customer adds the product to the cart
acceptance_criteria.then: the product is listed in the user's cart

acceptance_criteria.given: a customer has products in the cart and is signed in
acceptance_criteria.then: one order is created containing the selected items and their quantities
the system displays the product catalog without requiring a sign-in

acceptance_criteria.given: a guest visitor with items in the cart
acceptance_criteria.when: the user attempts to place an order
acceptance_criteria.then: the system mandates a sign-in before order processing proceeds

acceptance_criteria.when: the customer updates the quantity to a positive whole number
acceptance_criteria.then: the cart quantity is updated to that integer
the item is no longer in the cart

acceptance_criteria.when: a store owner or sales personnel updates the product details
acceptance_criteria.then: the product record reflects the updated information

acceptance_criteria.when: a store owner or sales personnel updates the account details
acceptance_criteria.then: the account record reflects the updated information
an order reference is displayed to the customer

acceptance_criteria.when: the user attempts to submit the order
acceptance_criteria.then: the submission is rejected and no order is created
